company.name: Kandil Glass
company.shortDescription: Kandil Industries Group manufactures steel, glass, spare parts, and industrial machinery, and trades in office furniture and equipment.
company.description: Kandil Industries Group is a manufacturing company that specializes in the production of steel, glass, spare parts, and industrial machinery. The company's product range includes flat steel sheets, glass containers such as jars, bottles, cups, mugs, tumblers, bowls, tea saucers, and vases. Kandil Industries Group also has a history in the trading of office furniture and equipment. Additionally, the company has a presence in the fields of mining and geology, showcasing its diverse industrial expertise.
